In terms of Regulation 17(1) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, not less than fifty per cent of the Board of Directors shall comprise non-executive directors. Further, where the chairperson of the Board of Directors is a non-executive director, at least one-third of the Board of Directors shall comprise independent directors and where the listed entity does not have a regular non-executive chairperson, at least half of the board of directors shall comprise of independent directors.
The tenure of Non-Executive Chairman on the Banks Board completed on 06.11.2025. During the period from 07.11.2025 to 31.12.2025, guideline relating to at least fifty per cent of the Board of Directors comprising independent directors was not adhered to. Further, during the period from 24.11.2025 to 31.12.2025, guideline relating to fifty per cent of the Board of Directors comprising non-executive directors was also not adhered to.
In terms of Clause 12(6) of the Nationalized Banks (Management and Miscellaneous Provisions) Scheme, 1970, if, for any reason, the Chairman is unable to attend a meeting of the Board, the Managing Director shall preside over that meeting.
Accordingly, in view of vacancy in the post of Non-Executive Chairman w.e.f. 07.11.2025, Shri Ashok Chandra, MD & CEO of the Bank has been appointed as the Chairman of the Board at its meeting held on 01.12.2025 until appointment of Non-Executive Chairman by DFS, MoF, GoI
In terms of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 read with the Nationalized Banks (Management and Miscellaneous Provisions) Scheme, 1970, the appointment of Directors on the Board of the Bank is done by Government of India except Shareholder Directors who are elected to the Board as per public shareholding of the Bank which currently permits to elect two Shareholder Directors on the Board.
The issue of appointment of non-executive directors have been made to DFS, MoF, GoI.
Further, Shri Ashok Chandra is also Director of PNB International Limited, United Kingdom.
